item.description:
Scriberman 1.0.11

What’s new

  • Get meeting suggestions from selected calendars and prepare a recording session.
  • Delete individual saved speaker profiles or clear them all in Settings.

Fixes

  • Corrected word attribution when speakers change or overlap in live transcription.
  • Kept speaker identities consistent throughout live recordings and saved transcripts.
  • Speaker renames in live transcripts now update speaker memory for future recognition.
  • Offline transcription and retranscription now show matched speaker names and use numbered labels for unrecognized speakers.
